title: Blueberry Banana Protein Smoothie
excerpt: A creamy, energy-packed shake for your mornings or after a workout. It combines the natural sweetness of our Guasca blueberries with the protein boost you need for the day.
imageAlt: Glass cup with a creamy deep purple smoothie, topped with whole fresh blueberries and a slice of banana.

ingredients.text: 1 ripe banana, peeled and frozen in slices
1 scoop of your favorite protein powder (vanilla or plain)
1 cup almond milk or your preferred milk

steps: Pour the milk of your choice into the blender jar to make blending easier.
Add the frozen banana slices, which will give the smoothie an incredibly creamy, cold texture without needing ice.
Add the scoop of protein powder, the chia seeds and the vanilla extract.
Add the Fresh Pick blueberries, grown in the high mountains of Guasca at over 2,800 meters, which will give that vibrant purple color and a balanced sweetness.
Blend on high speed for 1 or 2 minutes, until all the ingredients are fully combined and you have a smooth, silky consistency.
Serve immediately in a tall glass and top with a few whole fresh blueberries to enjoy their firm texture when you bite into them.
tips: For an even thicker texture, ideal for eating with a spoon like a bowl, reduce the milk to half a cup and add your favorite toppings on top.
Don’t remove the whitish coating (bloom) from your Fresh Pick blueberries; it is their seal of freshness and natural protection, since they are hand-picked and contain no artificial waxes.
You can leave individual containers with portions of banana and blueberries ready in the freezer to save time on busy mornings.
